verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV webhooks exist and let developers react to status changes without polling (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED), and dashboard/session status tracking corroborates lifecycle visibility, but the docs describe different event names than the story's specific set (created/processing/verified/requires-input) and no evidence confirms webhook payloads are cryptographically signed. missing for 10: documentation of webhook signature verification, and alignment with the exact lifecycle event taxonomy named in the story.
